reference_only_protocol.heldout: Freeze before third independent reference cohort and final-source candidates; investigate failure without refitting
reference_only_protocol.native_reference_spread: Per case/dimension: max(existing conservative ceiling, ceil(six-reference range * 1.25 / 0.005) * 0.005)
reference_only_protocol.p95_cv: Largest training case/cohort reference CV * 1.25, round up to0.005 and at least0.03
reference_only_protocol.pixels: All 15 unordered reference-video pairs per case, complete frames/windows and pinned canonical decoder
reference_only_protocol.scope: CUDA nightly only; no weekly or NPU campaign
reference_only_protocol.training_cohort_2: next independent CUDA nightly campaign after duplex fixture fix
reference_only_protocol.transient_noise: Maximum two-way reference-cohort excess * 1.25; ceil to 1ms startup-stall / 5ms TTFC

scope: Frozen reference-only calibration from two independent three-start CUDA nightly cohorts on vLLM 0.32.0. Fitted construction controls do not establish independent acceptance. Candidate allowances are unchanged; weekly, long and NPU workloads are not qualified. The next independent campaign must validate the frozen records.
